**Building from scratch for GW1: back Haaland's armband and build a 5-3-2 that hauls 60+ points.**

**✅ What's strong**
This £100.0m 5-3-2 projects a tasty 60.93 XI haul. Haaland is the obvious skipper — nailed, on pens, and a monster 0.86 xGI/90. B.Fernandes (7.44 xP) is the premium midfield engine on pens and free-kicks, while Virgil (6.33) offers clean sheets *and* threat from the back on a soft run. No fitness doubts flagged anywhere — clean bill of health.

**🔄 What I'd change**
Building from scratch, so prioritise the spine: Haaland up top, Fernandes in midfield. Pair with value picks — Enzo (6.49) is a cracking mid-price differential, on pens #2, and Watkins (5.3) or João Pedro (5.25) round out the forward line. At the back, Gabriel (5.83) brings attacking upside, and Hume (4.86) is superb enabler value at just £4.5m. Le Fée (4.91) is a sneaky budget mid.

**Bottom line: Load up on Haaland and Fernandes, sprinkle in Enzo and Hume for value, and you've got a squad primed to fly out the blocks.**
